parameters.name: recording-status
parameters.description: Change recording status. If true, starts recording. If false stop recording

parameters.name: recordType
parameters.description: Record type: 'mp4' or 'webm'. It's optional parameter.

parameters.name: resolutionHeight
parameters.description: Resolution height of the broadcast that is wanted to record.

parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: Optional base filename (without extension) for the output VOD.
